title: The Chipmaker That Quietly Passed Intel
hook: Intel Used To Be Twice As Big
source: Company annual reports and SEC filings (Intel Form 10-K; TSMC investor relations), approximate net revenue in USD: Intel roughly $43.6B (2010), $55.4B (2015), $77.9B (2020), $54.2B (2023), $53.1B (2024) and $52.9B (2025); TSMC roughly $13.3B (2010), $26.6B (2015), $45.5B (2020), $69.3B (2023), $88.3B (2024) and $121.4B (2025), per TSMC's own reporting and MacroTrends/Statista compilations. TSMC's revenue overtook Intel's around 2022-2023 and has since pulled far ahead on AI-chip demand.
